source.title: Nonlinear Singular Elliptic Problems: Recent Results and Open Problems

trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as the single zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/5005809.

zbMATH API identified record 5005809 as the book chapter 'Nonlinear Singular Elliptic Problems: Recent Results and Open Problems' with DOI 10.1007/3-7643-7385-7_12, pages 227-242, in Nonlinear Elliptic and Parabolic Problems.

Crossref confirmed the same DOI, title, and chapter PDF URL. OpenAlex confirmed the same DOI and title but reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only for accessible resolver pages. The Springer chapter page displayed a subscription-content notice, had Has Body=N, Full HTML=N, Open Access=N, and Access Type=no-access; the Crossref PDF URL redirected back to the restricted Springer landing page rather than a readable PDF.

Bounded recovery used exact-work searches by exact title plus PDF, exact title plus authors, and exact DOI. Candidate pages/files were rejected because Springer was restricted, Springer page-one preview contained only the first two chapter pages and no open-problem statements, the GBV PDF contained only cover/table-of-contents pages for the book, the Madrono author portal was metadata-only, and search-result candidates were citations or different works.
evidence_refs: "Nonlinear singular elliptic problems: recent results and open problems" PDF

trace.notes: No document map was created because no readable full PDF or full HTML source containing the chapter's problem statements was recovered. The workflow stopped before candidate extraction to avoid extracting questions from metadata, abstracts, citation pages, table-of-contents pages, search snippets, or a partial preview.
Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source within the bounded recovery pass.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/5005809.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
